entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I'm a bit lost. I ordered a jersey and it's just... it's not right. The website is so confusing, and I don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can certainly help you with that. Just so I understand correctly, when you say the jersey isn't right, is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference issue?

It's the size. It's the wrong size. I thought I ordered the right one based on the chart, but it's just way too tight. I really need to do an exchange for a bigger one, but I couldn't figure out the process online.
I understand completely. Getting the perfect fit is important. Let me pull up your account to get that exchange started for you. Do you have your order number handy?
I think so... hold on. Yes, it's VF-8675309.
Great, thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series Jersey, delivered on December 13th, 2025. That was about 40 days ago. Let me just double-check our policy.
Alright, yes. You are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process this for you. I'm so sorry you found the website confusing.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was worried I had missed the deadline. So I can get a different size?

Yes, absolutely. And because you're one of our VIP customers, I'm going to process this as a direct exchange and waive the return shipping fee. I'll also upgrade the shipping on your new jersey to get it to you faster. How does that sound?
Wow, that's amazing! Thank you so much, Sarah. That's a huge help. You've made this so much easier.

It's my pleasure. I'm sending the return label to your email now. Just print that out, place the jersey that was too tight back in the mailer, and drop it off. Your new size will ship out as soon as the return is scanned by the carrier. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again for all your help!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
